The completion-precheck call-graph cluster (_completion_precheck, _referencing_commit_exists, _is_live_ticket, _has_live_replacement_link, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) must be extracted into a new sibling module transition_close_precheck.py to split the file under the cap

test_transition_close.py must repoint its import of _referencing_commit_exists to the new transition_close_precheck module, while all monkeypatch-based tests remain unmodified
